text: Assumption: The strict separation of CryptoProvider instances without mutual key transfer serves to protect isolated hardware security domains (e.g. HSM versus software stacks) — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The strict separation of CryptoProvider instances without mutual key transfer serves to protect isolated hardware security domains (e.g. HSM versus software stacks) — is this correct?
norm: the strict separation of cryptoprovider instances without mutual key transfer serves to protect isolated hardware security domains e g hsm versus software stacks
assumption: The strict separation of CryptoProvider instances without mutual key transfer serves to protect isolated hardware security domains (e.g. HSM versus software stacks).
rationale: SWS_Cryptography p. 39 describes the lack of interoperability as an inherent property of cryptographic modules, but does not justify the hardware domain separation in detail.

original.text: Annahme: Die strikte Trennung von CryptoProvider-Instanzen ohne wechselseitigen Schlüsseltransfer dürfte dem Schutz isolierter Hardware-Sicherheitsdomänen (z. B. HSM gegenüber Software-Stacks) dienen — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die strikte Trennung von CryptoProvider-Instanzen ohne wechselseitigen Schlüsseltransfer dürfte dem Schutz isolierter Hardware-Sicherheitsdomänen (z. B. HSM gegenüber Software-Stacks) dienen.
original.rationale: SWS_Cryptography S. 39 beschreibt die fehlende Interoperabilität als inhärente Eigenschaft kryptografischer Module, begründet die Hardware-Domänenteilung aber nicht im Detail.
